audit.why: 50.00% over 32 games with a chart of Galio / Galio / Galio / Galio / Skill / Galio / Galio. The mechanics below explain the swings; the shape itself is defensible and was left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike is written without a cooldown, and spikes[1] says she 'can't follow your global'.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10 from 1000, Blooming Burst 9s, Shapesplitter 16s, Pop Blossom 120/105/90. Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140 onto an ALLY within 4000/4750/5500 — long-range, not global.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into spikes[0], mid, breakdown.cooldowns and loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: Inherent Glamour is never mentioned in either layer, only 'the clone' — so the single strongest Galio-specific interaction in the matchup is absent.
audit.why: Riot: 'Receiving immobilizing crowd control, casting damaging spells, damaging enemy towers as a non-champion, or your disguise taking damage equal to its healthbar breaks the disguise.' Shield of Durand's taunt, Justice Punch's knockup and Hero's Entrance's landing knockup are all immobilising, so any one of them strips a disguised Neeko instantly.
audit.corrected: Written into mid, late, spikes[0], report[5], loading and tldr.

audit.whatIsWrong: early tells the player Tangle-Barbs 'passes through minions, so stand behind your wave' — advice that makes the root worse.
audit.why: Riot: 'If the tangle KILLS AN ENEMY or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer.' Standing behind your own dying minions is exactly how the root arrives upgraded. The wave is not cover against this skillshot.
audit.corrected: Rewritten in early, wants.foe[0], breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two strings promise you can react to Pop Blossom — 'channeling Shield of Durand into the stun soaks most of it and your taunt cancels her channel', 'your W or R taunt cancels her ult mid-animation'.
audit.why: Two problems. Hero's Entrance does not taunt at all — Riot's text is a landing knockup — and Riot explicitly says of Pop Blossom that 'the preparation is HIDDEN if Neeko is disguised', so against a disguised Neeko there is no wind-up to react to. The kit gives no support for a taunt cancelling the ultimate either way.
audit.corrected: Replaced the unsupported cancel with what is verifiable: pre-channel rather than react, and any immobilise strips the disguise.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer writes 'Tangle Barbs' without the hyphen in eight strings; the full layer spells it correctly.
audit.why: The kit library gives the name as Tangle-Barbs. The packet flagged this as a probable wrong name and was right.
audit.corrected: Corrected in every string I touched (spikes[0], spikes[2], early, whys[0], mid, wants.foe[0]); untouched strings still carry the unhyphenated form.

edits.before: Once you have Q and E ranked, wait out her Tangle Barbs (E root) on cooldown, then E-knockup into a Colossal Smash auto for a chunk she can't poke back.
edits.after: Once you have Q and E ranked, wait out Tangle-Barbs (E, 12s), then E-knockup into a Colossal Smash auto — the knockup also strips any disguise she is wearing.

edits.before: Her one threat window is a landed Tangle Barbs root into Blooming Burst — never step up when both your W taunt and E dash are down.
edits.after: Her one threat window is a landed Tangle-Barbs into Blooming Burst — never step up when both your W taunt and E dash are down.

edits.before: Her Blooming Burst poke and Tangle Barbs chip feed your passive shield and Shield of Durand value rather than threaten you — her flat AP is exactly what your magic-amplified damage reduction sponges. The whole danger is a clean Tangle Barbs root: it's a line skillshot that passes through minions, so stand behind your wave and never give her a straight line to your body. At Level 1 you only have Q, so just last-hit with the tornado tip and respect her Level 2 all-in if she lands the root with Blooming Burst up.
edits.after: Her Blooming Burst poke and Tangle-Barbs chip feed your passive shield and Shield of Durand value rather than threaten you — her flat AP is exactly what your magic-amplified damage reduction sponges. The whole danger is a clean Tangle-Barbs: it roots everything it passes through, and Riot's text says it grows LARGER, FASTER and roots LONGER once it kills a unit or clips a champion — so your own dying minions are not cover, they are an upgrade. At Level 1 last-hit with the tornado tip and respect her Level 2 all-in.

edits.before: Land Tangle Barbs through your minions to root you, then chain Blooming Burst before your shield channel is up
edits.after: Kill a minion with Tangle-Barbs first so it arrives bigger and roots him longer, then chain Blooming Burst

edits.before: From Level 3 your W taunt into E-knockup is a real punish window — but only on her Tangle Barbs cooldown, because if the root lands while your E is winding up she sidesteps the dash and bursts you. Bait the root, then engage: the Shield of Durand channel eats her Blooming Burst and the taunt locks her for the kill. At 6 the lane stops being about the 1v1 — shove with Q and Hero's Entrance onto another lane, since you out-roam a Neeko glued to farming.
edits.after: From Level 3 your W taunt into E-knockup is a real punish window — but only on the 12-second Tangle-Barbs cooldown, because a root that lands while your E winds up leaves you burst for free. Bait the root, then engage: the Shield of Durand channel eats her Blooming Burst and the taunt locks her for the kill. Both the taunt and the knockup are immobilising, so either one strips Inherent Glamour off a disguised Neeko on contact. At 6, shove with Q and take another lane.

edits.before: Neeko becomes a pick and teamfight threat with a clone-flank Pop Blossom that can stun and delete a carry, but that's the exact channel your kit is built to punish — Shield of Durand's magic reduction soaks the burst and your W or R taunt cancels her ult mid-animation. The lane stays even because she scales into setup-burst while your solo damage plateaus, so your value is presence: save R for her engage and turn her flank into a 4v5. Always watch for the Shapesplitter clone baiting your taunt-release before the real fight starts.
edits.after: Neeko becomes a pick and teamfight threat with a clone-flank Pop Blossom that can stun and delete a carry, and Shield of Durand's magic reduction soaks most of that burst. What you cannot rely on is seeing it coming: Riot hides Pop Blossom's preparation entirely while she is disguised, so against a Neeko wearing an ally's face there is no wind-up to react to. Your answers are position and CC — any immobilise you land breaks Inherent Glamour outright. Save R for her engage, turn the flank into a 4v5, and watch for a Shapesplitter clone baiting your taunt-release.

edits.before: Her clone-flank Pop Blossom can delete a carry in a fight, but channeling Shield of Durand into the stun soaks most of it and your taunt cancels her channel.
edits.after: Her clone-flank Pop Blossom can delete a carry, and while she is disguised the preparation is hidden — pre-channel Shield of Durand rather than waiting for a tell.

edits.before: She scales into a clone-flank Pop Blossom that can one-shot, but your magic reduction and taunt punish that channel — late game is her pick threat versus your teamfight, and it nets out even.
edits.after: She scales into a clone-flank Pop Blossom that can one-shot, and while disguised there is no visible wind-up — but your magic reduction soaks it and any immobilise breaks the disguise. It nets out even.

edits.before: You only have Q at Level 1, but her Blooming Burst poke just charges your passive shield, so neither of you wins the opening — last-hit safe and dodge the Tangle Barbs line.
edits.after: You only have Q at Level 1, but her Blooming Burst poke just charges your passive shield, so neither of you wins the opening — last-hit safe and dodge the Tangle-Barbs line.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs: matchup-defining — Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. Track it before every punch. - Your W: the trade-flipper — never burn it early. - Your R: a map-wide win condition — spend it on allies' fights.
edits.after: - Tangle-Barbs: 12s at rank 1 from 1000, and it roots LONGER once it has killed a unit or clipped a champion — the wave is not cover. - Blooming Burst: 9s. - Shapesplitter: 16s. - Pop Blossom: 120s. - Your W: 18s.

edits.before: Track Neeko's Tangle-Barbs: Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. When it is down — Q-poke + punch the gap.
edits.after: Any immobilise breaks Inherent Glamour — your taunt or your knockup strips a disguised Neeko the moment it lands.

edits.before: - Galio vs Neeko - Track: Neeko Tangle-Barbs. - Punch only on its cooldown. - W is the trade-flipper, never burn it early. - Shove + R-roam from 6. - Anti-heal if he sustains.
edits.after: - Galio vs Neeko - Tangle-Barbs 12s: it roots longer after killing a minion, so the wave is not cover. - Your taunt or knockup breaks her disguise. - Shove + R-roam from 6.

edits.before: Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. Only punch once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Her 12s root gets bigger and longer after it kills a unit. Punch once it is spent.

edits.before: Neeko wins by landing Tangle-Barbs, punishing your E commit, and kiting your short range.
edits.after: Neeko wins by upgrading Tangle-Barbs through your wave, then bursting a rooted Galio.

edits.before: Your MR shield blanks him — trade Q + Colossal Smash when Tangle-Barbs is down. Galio wins the Tangle-Barbs cooldown windows.
edits.after: Your MR shield blanks her — trade on the 12-second Tangle-Barbs, and any immobilise you land strips her disguise.

notes: Best find here is that Inherent Glamour appears nowhere in either layer, even though Galio is close to its hard counter: Riot lists 'receiving immobilizing crowd control' as one of the things that breaks the disguise, and every piece of CC Galio owns qualifies. Second, early actively taught the wrong thing — 'stand behind your wave' against Tangle-Barbs, when the ability becomes larger, faster and longer-rooting after it kills a unit, so a dying minion line is the worst place to stand. Third, two strings promised the player can channel or taunt through Pop Blossom; Riot says the preparation is HIDDEN while she is disguised, and one of those strings also credits Hero's Entrance with a taunt it does not have. UNVERIFIED and therefore not written: whether Galio's taunt actually interrupts Pop Blossom's preparation — the kit has no channel flag on it and no interrupt data, so I replaced the claim rather than restating it. Note the content layer spells the root 'Tangle Barbs' in eight places while the full layer spells it 'Tangle-Barbs'; I corrected the six I touched.
